_about: Company statements shown at the top of an employer's pages. Keyed by employer slug (the /employers/<slug> static page and the /employer?e=<slug> profile). Read by scripts/build_employer_pages.py (static pages + the il-ssr:employer-notes block in employer.html). Only slugs listed here change; every other employer renders byte-for-byte as before. Numbers never come from this file. To remove a note: delete its entry and redeploy.

merit-logistics.label: Company statement
merit-logistics.text: Merit Logistics has told ImmiLane that it does not currently offer or participate in EB-3 or other employer-sponsored immigration programs and is not recruiting sponsored applicants. The figures on this page are historical U.S. Department of Labor PERM records. They are not a job posting or an offer of sponsorship.
merit-logistics.faqStatement: The company states that it does not currently offer employer-sponsored immigration programs (statement of November 23, 2026).
merit-logistics.source: Statement received from the company on November 23, 2026 (email to support@immilane.com).
